newsitem.title: INDIA: Higher arrivals drive some India cotton rates down.
newsitem.headline: Higher arrivals drive some India cotton rates down.

text.p: Indian Bengal-deshi cotton prices on Thursday fell on higher arrivals while other varieties were unchanged in a narrow price band, dealers said.
"Bengal-deshi fell on reports of the commencement of new crop arrivals at producing centres," one dealer.
In spot deals Bengal-deshi eased by 15 rupees to 860/890 rupees per maund (37.32 kg).
Saw-ginned cotton was steady at 1,675/1,700 rupees per maund in spot and October delivery was quoted at 1,650 rupees and November delivery at 1,635 rupees, one broker said.
